comment: The pace in week 6 was way too fast, we did recursion and trees in one week and I was lost.
The TAs were super patient in office hours. Thank you!
Gradescope kept crashing when I tried to submit assignment 3, lost an hour.
Lectures were clear, but the homework had little to do with what we covered in class.
I spent over 20 hours a week on this class. Way too much for 3 credits.
The live coding demos made loops and functions finally click for me.
honestly the instructions for project 2 were confusing, nobody knew what to hand in
My name is Arjun Mehta (arjun.m@uni.edu). Slides were great, but the midterm covered material we never saw in class.
emails to the professor went unanswered for two weeks
the weekly quizzes were a good check of understanding
Week 6 felt rushed, recursion needed at least another lecture.
Good course overall. However, the lab computers did not have Python 3.12 installed so we could not run anything.
The final project was far bigger than the time we were given.
Recorded lectures were posted quickly and made revision easy.
